scope: Phase5 isolated native OpenRouter provider/configuration adapter, scoped fallback and safe failure accounting

compiledRuntime.mode: compiled ESM native gateway/configuration + durable coordinator with simulated fetch/domain/storage/transport
compiledRuntime.scenario: metered primary failure -> secondary task read -> complete -> final -> text/flow acceptance -> owned recovery

adapter.routeSource: current production MODEL_CONFIG native-tool primary/secondary/last-resort values plus timeout/reasoning environment settings
adapter.unmeteredFallback: fail closed, no additional route or effects
adapter.usage: aggregate all verified attempts; AIProviderError retains known failed usage and marks incomplete accounting
adapter.pricedCeiling: explicit host rate ceiling must cover every active route; no price lookup/hardcoded model costs

productionRouting: Existing JS gateway remains active; no v2 router/sender admission
limitations: Native tool protocol only; legacy strict execute_turn schema, background extraction/synthesis and multimodal parity remain outstanding.

Host-priced ceilings are estimates; actual provider billing and cancellation behavior require independent evidence/evaluation.
Configured model/provider capabilities, real semantic quality, TTFT/p95 latency and cost remain unverified.
No legacy JS implementation retired; full strictTS maintained source/runtime migration still pending.
Mixed unknown effect/delivery reconciliation and authenticated engine handoff remain beforecanary prerequisites.
rollback: Remove isolated native provider/config bridge and optional scoped-provider/budget/error integration; preserve preceding productivity checkpoints, version fences and durable flow.
